messages:
maya: Anyone else seeing missing Kibana results for GPU node logs in eu-west1? I can find spans/traces for request id 9f3a8c7a in Jaeger, but Kibana returns zero hits when I search trace.id: "9f3a8c7a" on the log index. This started after a kube-proxy restart ~09:12 UTC.

diego: I saw conntrack saturation alerts for eu-west1 overnight, might be related. Can you paste the trace id and an example query? cc @infra-oncall :eyes:

maya: trace id is 9f3a8c7a. Loki query I ran: ```{job="gpu-logs", region="eu-west1"} |= "9f3a8c7a"``` returns nothing. Kibana query `trace.id: "9f3a8c7a"` zero hits. Jaeger has the span.

nina: Hmm. Could be the log-router dropped the connection during kube-proxy failover. Can you check kube-proxy logs around 09:10-09:20? Quick checks: `kubectl -n kube-system logs -l k8s-app=kube-proxy --since=30m` and `kubectl get pods -n logging -o wide | grep router`. Also confirm index pattern (maybe write alias changed).

infra-oncall: FYI I triggered a rolling restart of kube-proxy for a kernel patch rollout at ~09:05-09:15 UTC. Looking at Prom: `sum(rate(node_network_conntrack_entries[5m])) by (instance)` shows a spike that coincides with the window. Our log-router reported some TCP resets and increased drops: `log_router.dropped` metric jumped from 2 -> 23. Filing a follow-up. I'll try to trigger a reindex if logs still in hot-store.

loki-bot: Ingest system: reindex job scheduled for index-shard eu-west1-2026-03-17 at 10:05 UTC. Job id: reindex-1955. If logs exist in the hot store they will be reindexed into the queryable index.

diego: Also check if labels were mangled and logs landed in the wrong tenant/label set. We had a label-rename bug last month. Try a broader label_replace search: ```label_replace({job="gpu-logs"}, "region", "eu-west1", "r", "(.*)" ) |~ "9f3a8c7a"```

maya: Thanks — running the reindex id and the label_replace now. Also spinning up a temporary Grafana panel: `sum by(region) (increase(log_router.dropped[15m]))` to watch for recurrence. Will update when reindex finishes.

ingest-bot: Backfill started: reindex-1955 -> status: running. ETA ~12m. Will post results to this thread.

maya: Update: reindex completed and Kibana now shows ~1.2k logs for trace 9f3a8c7a. Root cause looks like conntrack evictions during the kube-proxy restart, which caused TCP state loss and intermittent log-router drops. Action items: tune kube-proxy conntrack-max on eu-west1 pools, increase router buffer/ttl, and add a Grafana SLO panel for log-loss (target <1%).

infra-oncall: Created ticket INF-3782 to track conntrack tuning + router hardening. Assigning to networking infra team. Thanks for the quick triage. :thumbsup:
